description: Foundation Electricity Infrastructure is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. The Foundation Electricity Infrastructure product contains three databases, Electricity Transmission Lines, Major Power Stations and Transmission Substations. The Electricity Transmission Lines Database presents the spatial location; in line format, all known high voltage electricity transmission lines that make up the electricity transmission network within Australia. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are EARTH SCIENCES, Published_External, electricity, foundation, infrastructure. It offers 3 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2025-10-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
